typed: Ask Ivette Salac: Who is missing? What's his name, and what was he doing yesterday?
note: The officer at the notice post is mentioned but never named, and Ivette's line about "a face I knew" is a bit vague. Otherwise a nice opening.

typed: I walk over to the officer at the notice post. "Are you Hobly? Ivette says you keep the ledger. What do you know about Falo Hayfoot, and what did you see yesterday?"
note: Ivette sending me to ask someone at the Crypt of Oakmere, a dangerous place, felt odd and out of nowhere. Otherwise fine, but she repeats "every hour" line a lot.

typed: I head to the Sleeping Stag and find Tobbo. "Tobbo, it's Nedett. Falo Hayfoot is missing. What did he carry for you last, and did he say where he was going?"
note: Hobly gave a decent answer, but Ivette said Hobly also saw the familiar face, and Hobly never mentioned it. Fine otherwise.

typed: I go to the room down the lane and knock gently. "I'm Nedett, from the temple. Tobbo sent me. May I come in? I'd like to ask about Falo, and I brought bread and broth."
note: Fine. Every NPC keeps deflecting to someone else, so I'm hoping the mother gives real information.

typed: I set the bread and broth down beside her and kneel by the pallet. "Not yet, mother, but I mean to. I'm Nedett. Please, what's your name? When did you last see Falo, and what did he say before he left?"
note: Nice scene, the boots and unused blanket are vivid. Hayfoot is a lot of people (Tobbo, Hobly, Falo), a bit confusing.

typed: I promise Agnes I'll come back. Then I return to the Stag and press Tobbo. "Agnes says Falo told her he had a job from the Stag, one more run before the bells. Who at the Stag sent him, Tobbo? Think hard."
note: Hobly, Falo and Tobbo all share the surname Hayfoot, yet everyone insists there's no kin, which is a bit odd. Otherwise the scene was vivid and the talking works well.

typed: /fix Tobbo tells me to take the bowl up to Agnes, but I already brought her the bread and broth and sat with her. He also says "I will pay for the bread and the broth" as if I hadn't yet.
note: Tobbo's reply ignores that I already visited Agnes and delivered the food. He's also vague and stalling, which feels like a dead end. Hobly shares Falo's surname, Hayfoot, and nobody remarks on it.

typed: I look for anyone else in the Stag's yard who might have seen Falo, a cook, a stable hand, a regular. "Did any of you see a boy named Falo here last night, or who spoke to him?"
note: The /fix reply was a bit muddled (mixed up which turn Tobbo said what) and the game didn't confirm Tobbo's line was an error, but it's fine. Still no concrete lead on who hired Falo.

typed: I sit down on the edge of the trough near Heldis. "I'm not asking you to owe me, Heldis. I'll buy you a drink at the Stag if you tell me what you do know. You said you know the lanes. Who runs the quay gate at night, and who would hire a child for a run after dark?"
note: Fine. Heldis is a nice gruff addition. The Tobbo fix response was a bit muddled, but this screen is good.

typed: "Fair enough, Heldis. No ale, no debts. Just one thing: you said the lanes. Has anyone been asking after Falo, or after the quay gate, who isn't from around here? What do you know about Tobbo, is he a man who forgets faces?"
note: Heldis is a good, prickly character. The scene is a bit repetitive: everyone points me to someone else, so I'm not getting new leads.

typed: I thank Heldis and head for the gate by the quay, keeping my back to a wall. Is there a gatekeeper or anyone loitering nearby I can talk to?
note: Heldis's scene was good and in character. She repeats "ask Tobbo" and "in daylight" a lot, so the leads are going in circles a bit.

typed: I turn from Vorak and walk over to Captain Helo Varande, keeping my voice low. "Captain, I'm Nedett, from the temple. A boy named Falo Hayfoot went missing last night, and his mother is sick in bed asking for him. Did you see a child pass through here before the bells?"
note: Fine. Vorak stonewalling is a bit repetitive after Heldis, but the nudge toward the captain is clear.

clues.learned: Ivette Salac does not know the way on, but someone at The Crypt of Oakmere would
the way on: toward The Crypt of Oakmere
